=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- `scripts/check_external_branch_advance.sh`:95 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `REMOTE_TIP_SHA` falls back to `FETCH_HEAD`, which can refer to an unrelated fetch result instead of `refs/remotes/origin/${TARGET_BRANCH}`.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers identified that this can compare against the wrong commit and produce false advance/no-advance decisions; one reviewer disagreed, but the highest reported severity is `critical`.
- `scripts/check_external_branch_advance.sh`:160-162 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The per-commit `gh api` calls in the SHA loop do not use the repository’s retry wrapper.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed transient GitHub API failures can make the helper fail open as `ADVANCE=unknown`, and one reviewer noted this also violates the repo’s API hygiene guidance; severities differed, so the highest is used.
- `scripts/check_external_branch_advance.sh`:104-122 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `LOCAL_HEAD_SHA` is not explicitly validated before the ancestor check.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed an invalid or missing local SHA can lead to confusing `git merge-base` failures or misclassification, though one reviewer framed this as a fail-open edge case rather than a bug.
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`:~1547 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The gate step does not explicitly check that `INITIAL_HEAD_SHA` is non-empty before invoking the helper.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed the helper already fail-opens safely, so this is only an unnecessary execution/logging issue, not a runtime correctness bug.
- `scripts/check_external_branch_advance.sh`:79-80 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: The remote URL parsing is considered fragile around non-standard GitHub URL forms.
  WHY: Only one reviewer reported this, and other reviewers explicitly called the pattern a false positive for standard SSH/HTTPS GitHub URLs; keep as a singleton.
- `agents.md`:558 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: The section numbering was reported as inconsistent.
  WHY: Only one reviewer reported it, while other reviewers said the heading was already fixed; keep as a singleton.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- `scripts/check_external_branch_advance.sh`:144-178 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]

  WHY: The reviewer says this violates GitHub API hygiene and can fail transiently without retry.
- `scripts/check_external_branch_advance.sh`:79-80 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: The URL pattern `*github.com[:/]*` may match non-standard remotes too broadly.
  WHY: The reviewer says repository extraction can fail on unusual remotes such as URLs containing `github.com` as a substring.
- `scripts/check_external_branch_advance.sh`:104 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: `LOCAL_HEAD_SHA` is not validated as a commit before use.
  WHY: The reviewer says invalid or empty SHAs can make later git commands fail silently and return `ADVANCE=unknown`.
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`:~1547, ~2631 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  PROBLEM: The workflow does not explicitly guard on `INITIAL_HEAD_SHA` before calling the helper.
  WHY: The reviewer says an empty value would only surface as a generic `ADVANCE=unknown` warning.

  WHY: The reviewer says the `${remote_url##*github.com[:/]}` expansion will not reliably strip modern HTTPS/SSH URLs as intended.
- `scripts/check_external_branch_advance.sh`:95 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: `FETCH_HEAD` is used as a fallback for `REMOTE_TIP_SHA`.
  WHY: The reviewer says `FETCH_HEAD` can point to a different ref from a previous fetch, leading to wrong comparisons.
- `scripts/check_external_branch_advance.sh`:111 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: `LOCAL_HEAD_SHA` and `REMOTE_TIP_SHA` are passed to `git merge-base` without ensuring the SHAs exist locally.
  WHY: The reviewer says an invalid or missing local commit can cause `git merge-base` to fail and be misread as an external advance.
- `scripts/check_external_branch_advance.sh`:160-162 | severity=medium | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: The per-commit `gh api` loop lacks retry wrapping.
  WHY: The reviewer says transient failures can trigger `ADVANCE=unknown`, and the repo’s API hygiene prefers retry-aware helpers.
- `agents.md`:558 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The section heading numbering was inconsistent.
  WHY: The reviewer says this was a documentation issue in the ledger/section numbering.
